note: The session's web search allowance ran out after the first twenty or so searches; after that only pages reachable directly were read (official court, city and school district sites, campaign sites found by address, Wikipedia's Michigan election articles). Blanks mean not found that way, not that nothing exists. No party's own endorsement page was found for anyone in this part. Myrene Kay Koch's campaign site says she was an elected Prosecutor before moving to Berrien County without naming the county, so no office is recorded for her. The 2007 Governor's release on Michael J. Beale's appointment refused the request (403) and was not used.
